extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from source-reviewed results text, Figure 3 transcriptomic panel, Figure 4 virucidal assay, and Figure 2 functional antiviral assay; automated placeholder mechanism labels were not promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Temporin-SHa has direct extracellular virucidal activity against HSV-1 in suspension, supported by a >2-log infectious-titer reduction after 10 µM SHa pre-incubation.
direct_assay_types: HSV-1 peptide pre-incubation followed by TCID50 end-point dilution assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports direct virucidal activity but does not directly image envelope disruption; envelope degradation remains an interpretation by analogy to prior temporin-Tb work.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SHa did not measurably induce the tested keratinocyte antiviral gene-expression program during HSV-1 infection, so its main supported mechanism is not host-response potentiation.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: temporin-SHa in HSV-1-infected primary human keratinocytes
direct_assay_types: qRT-PCR transcriptomic panel for IFNβ, IRF7, OAS1, IFIT1, ISG20, and viperin
mechanism_claims.limitations: Only the assayed innate-response markers and tested SHa concentration are covered; other intracellular mechanisms are not excluded.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LL-37 reduced HSV-1 replication while increasing multiple ISG mRNA signals in infected keratinocytes, supporting host-response potentiation rather than direct virucidal action at the tested non-cytotoxic concentration.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LL-37 in HSV-1-infected primary human keratinocytes
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper proposes IFNβ-independent ISG/IRF7 involvement; direct molecular target and receptor-level mechanism are not resolved.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: [K3]SHa shows functional anti-HSV-1 replication activity in keratinocytes at 2.5-5 µM, but this paper does not run the virucidal or transcriptomic mechanism assays for [K3]SHa.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: [K3]SHa against HSV-1 in primary human keratinocytes
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is inferred only from replication reduction; do not promote [K3]SHa to direct virucidal mechanism without a direct assay.

caution_findings.evidence_context: SHa virucidal activity is directly assayed, but envelope degradation is discussed by analogy rather than directly visualized.
[K3]SHa has source-supported replication reduction but no direct virucidal/transcriptomic mechanism assay in this paper.
LL-37 ISG/IRF7 induction is source-supported, but exact upstream signaling remains interpretive.
